name: liquid-glass-notification
title: Liquid Glass Notification
blurb: Glass-morphism notification cards with blur, glow, and expandable image preview.
description: Two LiquidGlassCard components with icon, title, description, timestamp, and optional expanded image preview. Uses blur and glow effects with backdrop styling.
use_when: You need decorative, visually rich notifications with glass-morphism styling and optional content expansion.
avoid_when: For simple, functional notifications; this is decorative and image-heavy.
a11y: Images have alt text. Expandable state is visual only; no keyboard alternative.
